questions.question:
Simplify the following expression.

[sqrt{25} + 12 ÷ 3 - {20 + (16 of 8 ÷ 16) - (54 ÷ 18 of (1)/(2))}]
If a + b + c = 6 and a² + b² + c² = 14, then what is the value of (a - b)² + (b - c)² + (c - a)² ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 6 and a2 + b2 + c2 = 14,

**Calculation:**

Let putting a = 1 , b = 2 and c = 3 

a + b + c = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6

So the value of 

(a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2 .

⇒ (1 - 2)2 + (2 - 3)2 + (3- 1)2 .

⇒ 1 + 1 + 4 = 6

**∴ The correct option is** 4

questions.question: An amount becomes double in 8 years on simple interest. In how many years would Rs. 25,000 become Rs. 1,00,000 with the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Simple Interest, the interest earned is directly proportional to the time period.

Interest required for an amount to double = P (1 time the principal)

Time taken to earn interest equal to the principal = 8 years.

New Principal = 25,000 and New Amount = 1,00,000 ⇒ Interest required = 75,000.

Since 75,000 is 3 times the principal (25,000), time required = 3 × 8 = 24 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

An amount becomes double in 8 years.

New Principal (P₂) = 25,000 and New Amount (A₂) = 1,00,000.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 
 
•

 SI = P

 SI = 75,000 (3P)
 
 
 Since SI is 3 times the Principal, Time = 3 × 8 = 24 years

**Calculations:**

Let the original principal be P.

⇒ Amount = 2P

⇒ SI₁ = 2P − P = P

⇒ P = (P × R × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ R = 100 ÷ 8 = 12.5%

For the second case:

⇒ P₂ = 25,000 and A₂ = 1,00,000

⇒ SI₂ = 1,00,000 − 25,000 = 75,000

⇒ 75,000 = (25,000 × 12.5 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 75,000 = 250 × 12.5 × T

⇒ 75,000 = 3125 × T

⇒ T = 75,000 ÷ 3125 = 24 years

**∴ The correct answer is 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is the principal, R is the rate of interest, and T is the time period.

Amount Formula

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

Shortcut for Multiples

If a sum becomes 'n' times in 'T' years at simple interest, then the Rate of Interest R = ((n − 1) × 100) ÷ T %.

questions.question: Shatabdi Express train covers 700 km in 5 hours and another 1012 km in 11 hours. What is the average speed of the train (in metres/second)?
questions.solution:
Given:

Shatabdi Express train covers 700 km in 5 hours and another 1012 km in 11 hours.

Concept used:

Distance = speed × time

Average speed = Total distance / Total time 

Calculation:

Total distance is 1012 + 700 = 1712 km

Total time is 5 + 11 = 16 hrs

Average speed = 1712 / 16

⇒ 107 km /hr

⇒ 107 × 5/18 = 29(13)/(18)m/s

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: In a company, a piece of work can be completed in 4, 6 and 18 days alone by R, S and T, respectively. In how many days will the work be completed if they work together? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
Given:

In a company, a piece of work can be completed in 4, 6 and 18 days alone by R, S and T, respectively.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 36 units ( Lcm of 4 . 6 and18 )

The efficiency of R is

⇒ 36 / 4 = 9 unit

Again, the Efficiency of S is,

⇒ 36 / 6 = 6 unit

Again, the Efficiency of T is,

⇒ 36 / 18 = 2 unit

Total Efficiency,

⇒ 9 + 6 + 2 = 17 unit

The number of days required, 36/17 = 2.12 days

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: In a ΔABC, if ∠A = 90°, AC = 5 cm, BC = 9 cm, and in ΔPQR, ∠P = 90°, PR = 3 cm, QR = 8 cm, then:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Compare corresponding parts of right-angled ΔABC and ΔPQR.

In ΔABC: Hypotenuse BC = 9 cm and Side AC = 5 cm.

In ΔPQR: Hypotenuse QR = 8 cm and Side PR = 3 cm.

Congruence (RHS) requires Hypotenuse 1 = Hypotenuse 2 and Side 1 = Side 2.

Since 9 ≠ 8 and 5 ≠ 3, the triangles cannot be congruent.

**∴ The correct answer is ΔABC ≇ ΔPQR.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔABC: ∠A = 90°, AC = 5 cm, BC = 9 cm (Hypotenuse)

ΔPQR: ∠P = 90°, PR = 3 cm, QR = 8 cm (Hypotenuse)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89b0ac819db213682b3bf2149aa361401a41fe3ddac32e59e458778a5e09dee8.png] 

**Formula Used:**

RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side) Congruence Rule: Two right-angled triangles are congruent if the hypotenuse and one side of one triangle are equal to the hypotenuse and the corresponding side of the other triangle.

⇒ In ΔABC, using Pythagoras theorem: AB² = BC² − AC²

⇒ AB² = 9² − 5² = 81 − 25 = 56
⇒ AB = √56 cm ≈ 7.48 cm

⇒ In ΔPQR, using Pythagoras theorem: PQ² = QR² − PR²

⇒ PQ² = 8² − 3² = 64 − 9 = 55
⇒ PQ = √55 cm ≈ 7.41 cm

⇒ Comparing the dimensions of ΔABC and ΔPQR:

⇒ Hypotenuse: BC (9 cm) ≠ QR (8 cm)
⇒ Side 1: AC (5 cm) ≠ PR (3 cm)
⇒ Side 2: AB (√56 cm) ≠ PQ (√55 cm)

⇒ Since none of the corresponding sides are equal, the triangles are not congruent.

**∴ The correct answer is ΔABC ≇ ΔPQR.**

**__Additional Information__**

RHS Congruence Rule

If in two right-angled triangles, the hypotenuse and one side of one triangle are equal to the hypotenuse and one side of the other triangle, then the two triangles are congruent.

SSS Congruence Rule

Two triangles are congruent if all three sides of one triangle are equal to the corresponding three sides of the other triangle.

Congruence vs. Equality

Congruent triangles (≅) have the exact same shape and size (identical sides and angles), whereas equal triangles (=) usually refers to triangles having equal area even if shapes differ.</p

questions.question: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 210 m. When the policeman starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the thief is 25 km/h and that of the policeman is 32 km/h, then how far would the thief have run (in m) before he is overtaken?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 210 m.

When the policeman starts the chase, the thief also starts running.

The speed of the thief is 25 km/h and that of the policeman is 32 km/h

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Relative speed is (32 -25) × 5/18 = 35/18 m/s

Time taken to catch the thief 210 × 18/35 = 108 sec

Distance covered in that time by the thief is,

25 × 5/18 × 108 = 750 m

**∴ The correct option is 4**

As per the question,

⇒ 64 + 4y = 55 + 10y

questions.question: A man and a woman can finish a work together in half the time taken by a woman and a boy together. A boy can finish the work alone in 20 days and 2 women together can finish it in 30 days. In how many days will the work be finished by 4 men?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by (man + woman) = (1/2) × Time taken by (woman + boy)

A boy alone can finish the work = 20 days

2 women can finish the work = 30 days.

**Concept used:**

If total work is constant then,

Time ∝ (1/efficiency)

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

Calculation:

2 women can finish the work = 30 days.

1 woman can finish the work = 30 × 2 = 60 days

Time taken by (man + woman) : Time taken by (woman + boy) = 1 : 2

Efficiency of (man + woman) : Efficiency of (woman + boy) = 2 : 1

(Woman + boy) = (3 + 1) = 4

⇒ 1 unit = 4 units/day

⇒ 2 units = 4 × 2 = 8 units/day

Efficiency of (man + woman) = 8

Efficiency of man = 8 - 1 = 7 units/day

Time taken to complete the work by 4 men = 60/(4 × 7)

⇒ 60/28 = 15/7 = 2.14 days

**∴ The correct answer is 2.14 days.**
